Initial release of web-utilities-research — a general-purpose web intelligence toolkit powered by the Crawlora API.

- Scrape and extract structured content from any URL, with options for markdown, HTML, or schema-based JSON.
- Identify a website's tech stack.
- Perform geocoding (address to coordinates, and reverse).
- Compare cost of living and price indices between cities/countries (Numbeo integration).
- Lookup company import/export trade data (ImportYeti).
- Get website traffic statistics (SimilarWeb).
- Resolve brand identity from a domain (name, logo, colors).
- Full endpoint and setup instructions included; API key required.
